I replied to Pree in a thread under their correction in #central-team. The reply confirms the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47, not Dock 23.

They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. My earlier "Dock 23" reply is still in its thread above, but the correction is now in the same channel for anyone who reads both.
